description: `Tackle.Review.Detector.failed_sample/3` classifies a failed detector run: finished runs count as complete samples, runs that failed earlier as incomplete ones. The two cond branches are swapped.

edits.find:
ReportFindings.finished?(messages, review) -> {:ok, findings, usage}
      findings != [] -> {:incomplete, findings, reason, usage}
edits.replace:
findings != [] -> {:incomplete, findings, reason, usage}
      ReportFindings.finished?(messages, review) -> {:ok, findings, usage}

issues.anchor:
findings != [] -> {:incomplete, findings, reason, usage}
      ReportFindings.finished?(messages, review) -> {:ok, findings, usage}
issues.description: `findings != []` is tested before `ReportFindings.finished?/2`, so a run that recorded its last report and then failed is reported as an incomplete sample (and its unit listed in `incomplete_units`) instead of a completed one, contradicting the moduledoc.
